verdict.rationale: The pack has a first-party API Reference alongside Dashboards and Monitors docs, which points to programmatic management of dashboards and alerts. None of the cited snippets explicitly shows dashboard or monitor creation via API, JSON export/import, or Terraform. missing for 10: explicit evidence of dashboard/monitor JSON definitions, a Terraform provider, documented API endpoints for creating dashboards and monitors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of repeatable provisioning.
